notes: Smart Split fix: "I've already paid" no longer shows immediately when you open a split - it only appears after you've actually tapped Settle Up via UPI at least once. Previously it sat right next to the real payment button from the start, with zero friction, which made it too easy to mark yourself paid without actually paying. As a side effect this is also more honest: tapping Settle Up via UPI no longer auto-marks you as paid the instant the UPI app opens (it couldn't reliably tell if you actually completed the payment) - now it requires that explicit follow-up confirmation instead of assuming.
